title: Does the BitQuilt core say what the protocol says it says?
done_when: Every statement has a verdict with a quote from CORE.md.

claim/*.brief: Statement {n} about the BitQuilt core: {claim.text} Read docs/CORE.md in the BitQuilt repository and return whether the core says this, with a quote of at most 25 words from it as evidence.

claims.text: A claim on a piece is a lock that keeps other keys from working it.
The plain-text gate decides whether a reveal is valid and so decides the map.
Two events on one problem that share a receipt time are ordered by their ids.
